gate: Su 2026 M397 native-method source metadata qualification
permitted_operations: parse selected GSM metadata fields only
record title, source name, characteristics, data_processing, relation, supplementary file and platform metadata
confirm all prospectively frozen M397 RNA timepoints are represented
forbidden_operations: change the frozen M397 timepoint membership
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
pass_rule: all frozen M397 RNA timepoint GSMs are present and metadata explicitly identifies the processing/source route needed for the published native analysis
fail_rule: missing frozen GSM or metadata too ambiguous to identify the native processed expression input
